title: Maimane Targets ZANU-PF Over Cross-Border Immigration Crisis
detail: South African opposition leader Mmusi Maimane intensified political pressure on anti-immigrant tensions by directly targeting Zimbabwe's ruling ZANU-PF party, holding it responsible for driving cross-border migration that fuels xenophobic violence inside South Africa. Maimane's intervention escalates the diplomatic dimension of the ongoing immigration crisis.

media.caption: Opposition leader Mmusi Maimane targets Zimbabwe's ZANU-PF over cross-border immigration crisis
